result.rationale: The diff shows `totalPages: function() { ... return Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1; }`. When user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 100/50), floor(2)+1 = 3 instead of the correct 2, so showingLast is false at the real last page and `next` advances offset to user_count (Math.min(offset+limit, user_count)), fetching an empty page. This is a verifiable off-by-one defect introduced by the new pagination code.

judged_text: totalPages computed property in admin-group.js.es6 uses Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, producing an off-by-one extra empty page when user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 100 members, limit 50 yields 3 pages instead of 2) — should use Math.ceil(user_count / limit), causing spurious server requests for empty pages
